tests.title: Member import never overwrites an existing member's points, level, spending or opt-in
tests.goal: A bulk import cannot silently damage existing customer accounts.
preconditions: A QA member we created, with points, a level and opt-in No; note them
data: Import file: one row with the QA member's email/phone and different name, points, level and spending; include a conflicting opt-in only if the current template supports it; one new QA member

steps.text: Customers > Import > Import CSV > download the sample, fill it and upload the file once
Open the existing QA member and the new one

expected.text: The existing member is refused as a duplicate (or only allowed fields change, as the screen states); points, level, spending and opt-in are unchanged
Cleanup: delete the new member only with explicit approval; retain it when the user requests this

checks.label: The existing member is refused as a duplicate (or only allowed fields change, as the screen states); points, level, spending and opt-in are unchanged
Cleanup: delete the new member only with explicit approval; retain it when the user requests this

notes: Single approved import. Existing MEMy001164525 refused as duplicate mobile; unchanged 738 points, Level 2, $368.00 Level spending, Opt-in No. New MEMy001164528 created: Level 1, 542 points = 42 base + 500 Register Reward. No consent column, so conflicting opt-in could not be supplied. QA list 22 and members retained per user request; cleanup waived, not performed. Q-020/Q-021/Q-022 capture ancillary observations; SCRM-181 written but not run. No retry or other test executed.
